stem:
Wasim must draw a symmetric rangoli petal pattern with ruler and compass. Equal arm lengths and a mirror line are required before the outer arcs are traced.

Which plan is correct?

options.text: Call the finished picture support lines only, without fixing equal arms or the mirror line first.
Trace the outer arcs first, and treat equal arm lengths and the mirror line as optional afterward.
First construct the mirror line and equal arm lengths (and any equal repeated angles needed); then trace the outer arcs along those constraints.
Say that tracing the outer arcs is what creates the mirror line and equal arms, instead of building those supports first.

teacher.key_rationale: Exact symmetric designs fix support structure first—mirror line, equal arms, equal angles—then trace visible arcs. Naming only support lines, skipping the supports, or reversing arcs and supports all miss that order.
